narrative.intro: At and T Enterprises obligated $166M in FY2027 to date across 10 awards, with an average award size of $16.6M and year-over-year obligations down 84.0%. At and T Enterprises' FY27 obligations sit far below prior fiscal years: FY22 obligations were $349M, FY23 obligations were $778M, FY24 obligations were $941M, FY25 obligations were $1B, and FY26 obligations were $1B. At and T Enterprises received the bulk of FY2027 to date funding from the Department of Veterans Affairs, which obligated $164M. At and T Enterprises also had smaller obligations from the Department of Justice, which obligated $1.6M, and the United States Trade and Development Agency, which obligated $105K. At and T Enterprises had zero obligations in FY2027 to date from the General Services Administration, Environmental Protection Agency, National Aeronautics and Space Administration, Department of Defense, and Executive Office of the President. These figures are fiscal year to date and represent contract obligations unless otherwise noted.

sections.heading: What changed in FY2027 to date compared with prior years?
sections.body: At and T Enterprises' obligations in FY2027 to date fell 84.0% year over year. At and T Enterprises' FY27 obligations are $166M, compared with FY26 obligations of $1B and FY25 obligations of $1B. The Department of Veterans Affairs drove most of the FY27 total by obligating $164M.

sections.heading: Who are the top buyers of At and T Enterprises in FY2027 to date?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs is the top buyer, obligating $164M to At and T Enterprises. The Department of Justice and the United States Trade and Development Agency are the only other agencies with recorded FY27 obligations at $1.6M and $105K respectively; several major agencies reported $0 obligations to At and T Enterprises in FY27 to date.

faq.q: How much does At and T Enterprises make from federal contracts?
faq.a: At and T Enterprises has $166M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. At and T Enterprises has 10 awards so far this fiscal year and an average award size of $16.6M.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from At and T Enterprises?
faq.a: The Department of Veterans Affairs is the primary buyer, obligating $164M to At and T Enterprises in FY2027 to date. The Department of Justice obligated $1.6M and the United States Trade and Development Agency obligated $105K. The General Services Administration, Environmental Protection Agency, National Aeronautics and Space Administration, Department of Defense, and Executive Office of the President each obligated $0.
